articles.title: 'Wait For Several Times More Powerful Blows': Putin Vows DEVASTATING STRIKES Against Ukraine
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has issued a stark warning to Ukraine over Kyiv's repeated drone attacks on Moscow's oil infrastructure. The Russian leader said Moscow will respond with even greater force to Ukrainian attacks on Russian territory, declaring that future retaliation would be "several times more powerful." The warning comes after Ukraine said its drone forces struck fuel tankers linked to Russia's sanctioned "shadow fleet" in the Sea of Azov, while Russia has continued large-scale drone and missile attacks across Ukraine. Overnight strikes in Zaporizhzhia killed civilians and damaged residential buildings, according to Ukrainian authorities.

articles.title: 'Someone must be held accountable...': Harris County DA launches probe into Houston ICE shooting
articles.description: Community leaders are continuing to demand an independent investigation into a deadly shooting by an ICE agent.Harris County District Attorney Sean Teare and Harris County Commissioner Rodney Ellis announced that they will conduct an investigation into the fatal shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo at a press conference on Monday. But Teare said that while he will work to find out what happened in the death of Salgado Araujo, he is limited in the evidence that he is allowed to get as federal investigators will be conducting its own investigation. “We’re running this investigation so that we can be transparent so all of Houston, Texas, the U.S. that if someone needs to be held accountable, we can do that,” Teare said. The independent investigation by the DA’s office will run into tough waters, especially since the ICE agents did not wear body cameras and there is not yet any video that has been released that shows the actual shooting or the incident that led to it.
